i warned you... i WARNED YOU... this isn't my fault... this ISN'T MY FAULT, you understand?! shit... SHIT
got the weirdest call one day, from some slithery little shitbird. preening his feathers and puffing himself up like he was trying to prove something
Update boolean FlareLizzie2
telling us all about how important he was, how this city was "failing" and "losing faith" and how we could "help him in his noble cause to set it straight"

nothing worse in this world than watching idiots misuse your words for their own goals
so, of course we said yes. mainly just because i knew we had to piss that little shitbird off and show him just how tiny his dick actually is
wish i'd believed the tabloids about the whole weird plague thing, though
that was pretty effin' shit
Ooof.
You caught techrot?
0/5 stars. would not visit again. as i'm lying there in the tour bus, there's a knock on the door
Entrati?
Let me guess.
ding ding ding.
psh you know how the story goes. magical mystery cure? promises me that i'll become a performer the likes of which the world has never seen?
etcetera, etcetera, etcetera.
that shitbird wanted a concert? well he got one all right. now, my stage character's always been a bit... much
always been me with the volume cranked up as high as it could go
but now? *now?* it was like i was running higher than the clouds, running on some kinda juice i didn't even know *existed*
Then what?
Void's a helluva drug.
standing on that stage, the new me, i felt... alive. truly alive. more me than i'd ever felt before. it was glorious. freeing. i felt like i was flying
what?
we gave Höllvania a concert they'd never forget. that shitbird wanted us to give them hope? and faith? we did. in themselves
Never mind, continue.
next thing we know they're flipping scaldra trucks and pulling over statues hahaha
that lil shitbird was so pissed...
should've known it would have costed us...
well... them...
I heard.
What happened...?
yeah.
shitbird decided he'd get his show. one way or another. only this time? it wouldn't be a concert
couldn't stop them. too many of them. vs just me? i see you chewing through them like candy...
it's the kind of show you only get to put on once...
me over here like a baby giraffe figuring out where its legs are supposed to be
couldn't do much except just... watch them die...
shitbird did it on national tv, too...
crowing about the ratings like it was something to be proud of...
What did you do next?
I hate that people like that exist in this world.
I'm so, so sorry, Flare...
I wish I could do something to change it, but...
got my anger out, more or less
can't let yourself get twisted up by hate. even doing what you do, being a soldier, having to kill every day, all day -
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
for better or worse
hating them is something i suppose i'd try not to do. but i guess if the other option were to feel nothing, that'd be somehow worse, i feel?
some things just happen. i'm not the first or the last person to suffer a tragedy in this world
no. i get it. kaya - she prefers nova, sorry - explained it to me. time travel's complicated
but... random thought, while we're talking about my...transformation.
if we don't experience things, worse things happen, you know?
everywhere you look, someone's lost somebody. love and grief are what define us.
and... some things just happen. i'm not the first or the last person to suffer a tragedy in this world

please. a guess is better than nothing. but please hurry... just in case...

no just please explain what you were talking about please
